description: This file declares the CloudStoreImplementation class, which implements the IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for cloud storage functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for registering notifications, setting, getting, and deleting key-value data within a specified namespace, primarily operating on an internal _accountStore2 object.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage and configuration interfaces for cloud store operations, managing internal store object and interface mapping.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the storage implementation with the given service shell.

methods.name: uint32_t Register(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the internal store if available.

methods.name: uint32_t Unregister(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the internal store if available.

methods.name: uint32_t SetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,const string & value,const uint32_t ttl)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair within a specified scope and namespace, using the internal account store.

methods.name: uint32_t GetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,string & value,uint32_t & ttl)
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a key within a specified scope and namespace.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteKey(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key)
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within a namespace and scope.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteNamespace(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns)
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace within a specific scope.
